headline: Approved salary increases for the superintendent, two administrators, and non-union professionals, plus a Hamden High School Dance Team trip to Orlando.
summary: Approved salary increases for the superintendent, Tom Ariola, Erin Bailey, and non-union professionals. Also approved the BOE Goals, a Dance Team trip to Orlando, Florida, an energy savings RFQ, and a consent agenda that included budget transfers. Tom Ariola may continue negotiating a possible three-year extension of the First Student transportation contract.
decisions: Approved the Hamden High School Dance Team field trip to Orlando, Florida, February 4-8, 2027, unanimously.
Approved the RFQ for Energy Savings Performance Contracting Services, unanimously.
Authorized Tom Ariola to continue negotiating a possible three-year extension of the First Student transportation contract, unanimously.
Approved the consent agenda, including budget transfers, unanimously.
Approved a 2% salary increase for the Superintendent, unanimously.
Approved a 2.5% salary increase for Tom Ariola and a 3% salary increase for Erin Bailey, unanimously.
Approved 2.5% salary increases for non-union professionals, unanimously.
